name: @certscore/scan-core
description: CertScore v2 browser evidence capture core.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @certscore/contracts build && pnpm --filter @certscore/vendor-resolver build && pnpm --filter @website-signal-risk-scanner/shared build && pnpm --filter @website-signal-risk-scanner/web-bot-auth build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration-fixtures:consent: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='first-layer|choice controls|CMP recapture|CMP script|supplemental full-page|off-viewport|bare generic|post-screenshot consent|ambiguous consent|soft module deadline|parent scan is cancelled' src/integration-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.test:policy:fast: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='does not render a guessed privacy path|builds a bounded canonical www retry|does not repeat a canonical host retry|homepage failure still derives common-path locale hints|homepage-failed fallback schedules|removes consent-banner preambles|compact English policy sections|retained policy sections prefer a substantive transfer|follows a rendered dated privacy index|substantive governing policy remains a policy document' src/policy-surface-scanner.test.ts
scripts.test:policy:timing-canary: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='protects one strong observed privacy link after the soft budget|bounds a Ford-like stalled homepage fetch|rendered policy document fallback when direct policy fetch times out|honors a parent absolute deadline' src/policy-surface-scanner.test.ts
scripts.test:policy-timing-quality: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='fast mode|thin shell|canonical GDPR Transparency|late-rendered localized|common-path fallback|speculative Nano|observed links are declined|rendered policy document fallback|rendered footer links' src/policy-surface-scanner.test.ts
